evidence.title: U.S. debt ceiling saga softens Fed's QT: McGeever
evidence.summary: Explains that the Fed is reducing its balance sheet by $95 billion a month through Quantitative Tightening (QT), which directly impacts total assets. It also notes that falls in the TGA and reverse repurchase facility can offset the decline in the Fed's bond holdings, acting as a countervailing factor.
